Lance Gooden

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 5, Dallas County, Texas · Incumbent

U.S. Representative for Texas's 5th Congressional District (incumbent)

Lance Gooden is a Republican who has represented Texas's 5th Congressional District since January 3, 2019. Before that he served in the Texas House of Representatives. He ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary, winning 52,265 votes, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election under district lines Texas redrew in August 2025.

Where Gooden stands

Drug policy / synthetic opioids
Introduced the End Gas Station Heroin Act. The bill would permanently schedule synthetic opioids sold in 'synthetic kratom' products, target manufacturers and distributors, and create a federal process to address emerging substances.

Background

  • U.S. Representative, Texas District 5, 2019–present
